name: Consistency
text:
A set of !!{sentence}s~$\Gamma$ is \emph{inconsistent} iff there is a
finite set $\{!B_1, \dots, !B_n\} \subseteq \Gamma$ and a closed
!!{tableau} for the set
\[
\{
  \sFmla{\True}{!B_1}, \dots,
  \sFmla{\True}{!B_n}  
  \}.
\]
If $\Gamma$ is not inconsistent, we say it is \emph{consistent}.
